usage_short: viewer login | status | machines | pair | sessions | read | send | answer | interrupt | end | receipt
login_usage: usage: clawdline cloud viewer login [--wait 10m] [--name label]
wait_help: how long to wait for approval
status_none: viewer authorization is absent; run `clawdline cloud viewer login`
key_missing: viewer_key_missing: the viewer signing key is missing or unreadable
environment_mismatch: viewer_environment_mismatch: this identity belongs to another Cloud API
status_ready: viewer device %s on account %s; key %s; use `viewer machines` to inspect pairing
flow_unavailable: viewer_flow_unavailable: this Cloud API cannot authorize a CLI viewer device yet
authorized: authorized viewer device %s; pair each target machine before reading it
wrong_token_role: viewer_token_mismatch: the Cloud API did not mint a token for this viewer key
pair_usage: usage: clawdline cloud viewer pair --machine ID --fingerprint FINGERPRINT [--wait 10m]
login_required: viewer_login_required: authorize this local viewer first
pair_offer:
Machine fingerprint %s
Run on that machine: clawdline cloud pair --offer %s
Waiting for encrypted handover…
machines_none: no Cloud machines are registered on this account
sessions.usage: usage: clawdline cloud viewer <sessions|read|send|answer|interrupt|end|receipt> [--machine ID] [--session ID --generation HEX] [--before CURSOR for read]
error.disabled: cloud_disabled: turn Cloud on before using remote Sessions
error.pair: viewer_machine_not_paired: pair this viewer with the selected machine
error.revoked: viewer_machine_revoked: access to this machine was revoked
error.offline: viewer_machine_offline: this machine is offline; nothing was queued
error.changed: execution_generation_changed: select the Session's current execution again
error.status: viewer_status_unavailable: a current Session target could not be proved
error.uncertain: receipt_outcome_unknown: query the request receipt before acting again
error.machine: viewer_machine_not_found: no such Cloud machine is visible
